title: Sistema Sendero – Parque Nacional
description: Backend system for Panama's National Park Camino de Cruces. Handles visitor registration with encrypted PII, trail management, post-visit surveys, comments with ratings, and Excel report generation for park staff.

title: NovaMind – EmotionHUB
description: AI-powered organizational climate analysis system that detects employee emotions, stress levels, and organizational blockages through NLP transformers and an autonomous conversational agent.
